scope: Forensic findings; source of authority is root plan.md

findings.finding_and_disposition: Tolerance-expanded TP numerator is divided by original positive count; ordinary recall/F1 labels become invalid. Replace with strict point metrics and separately named event metrics.

ROC uses expanded positives with original-positive denominator, clips TPR, thins thresholds to 200, omits a proper endpoint policy; reported AUROC is not standard AUROC. Replace with exact grouped ranking/curve arithmetic.

Trapezoidal “PR AUC” inherits the inconsistent recall axis and is ambiguous relative to AP. Specify and independently recompute average precision; report PR area only under a separately defined convention.
Queue update subtracts `service_time/inter_arrival`, reversing the physical relationship. Replace with exact FCFS service/wait recurrence or a explicitly modeled valid queue.
Shedding was already included in timed work per original input sample, then applied again through `mu/(1-shed_fraction)`. Whole pipeline costs require direct measurement; no second shedding bonus.

Whole-trace arrival-rate calibration, inserted mean first interval, and whole-trace 99th-percentile queue normalization use future data. A deployed controller needs current telemetry and calibration learned before evaluation.
Acquisition errors can substitute random prices and still generate ordinary result files. Remove fallback from empirical reachability; fail with retained error evidence.

Requested 100 events of each type silently degrades when space is exhausted. A reproduced seed has 100 points, 23 shifts, zero volatility bursts. Existing table has no burst rows. Withdraw the “300/three-type” experimental description.
Days sampled with replacement; 150 trials reuse only 96 distinct asset-days and 50 seed labels. Independent population inference cannot use row count as N. Rebuild hierarchical/unit-key design.
Sorts only by seed and truncates unequal lengths; seed repeats across regimes. Join exact unit keys, reject duplicates/missing pairs, and aggregate within independent units before inference.
Analytical/simulated maxima are described as sustainable system throughput, without a measured streaming runtime. Register modeling and runtime measurement as separate evidence tiers.
Backend precomputes injected labels and replay outputs; dashboard displays `is_anomaly` as “Spike Detected.” Retire this path as detector evidence.
Drops equal timestamp/price trades and provider IDs, affecting arrivals, loads, and lineage. Regenerate from raw preserving all distinct trade IDs.
Globally disables HTTPS certificate verification. Replaced by a local strict reader; downloads must use verified TLS.
Missing days/errors are skipped and caches are trusted without input/transform hash binding. Require a complete planned source manifest and retained acquisition failures.
Irregular event arrays are labeled/filtered with assumed 100 Hz, and PSD uses 1 Hz elsewhere. Use event-domain units or an explicitly causal uniform grid.

Analog cutoff passed through bilinear transform without prewarping is not exactly the requested digital cutoff; direct polynomial form is less robust than SOS. Use digital SciPy design/SOS on a verified grid.
KAMA warmup applies alpha=1 but reports a slow-SC pole; initialization is inconsistent with steady filtering. Specify warmup and report the actual coefficient.
First-sample initialization sets y[0]=x[0]; the supposed impulse/step plots are not zero-state responses. Separate startup conventions; verify against closed forms.

Frozen pole locations and an arbitrary slew bound do not prove claimed quasi-static behavior or general time-varying stability. Give the actual first-order convexity/contraction proof and qualify frozen views.
Scale includes current residual, startup uses backfill, and unsupported estimators lack validation. Use prior-window scale/center and explicit warmup/floor policy.

`alpha_max=0.08253` is reused from one inspected load trace. It is neither a universal calibration nor proof of equal bandwidth. Remove from defaults; fit a preregistered matching criterion only on development data.
Filtering a compressed subsequence changes the clock and adaptive slew semantics; generic Butterworth/KAMA use is not automatically physically valid. Define skip/update semantics per operator.
Latencies are averaged only over observed detections/admissions, silently omitting misses and often labeled as detection delay. Preserve misses/censoring and measure physical task-alert latency.
UDP `sendto` without a receiving/acknowledged consumer measures send-call overhead, not database/alert end-to-end service. Benchmark actual downstream operators and receipt completion.

Admission-mask construction is outside the timed region; trials are batched per config; allocations and coefficient costs differ; IQR is displayed as if a symmetric interval. Measure named scopes and randomize/interleave trial blocks.
Power samples before/after a short workload are not integrated energy during execution; archived power column is missing. No energy result can be claimed from those rows.
Single-run quality, multi-seed CI, and separate modeled throughput are joined by names, without identical keys/configs/input hashes. One Pareto row must come from a coherent experiment bundle.
Nondominated membership does not mean better than every baseline without loss. Report tradeoffs and uncertainty; identical points need no invented “partially dominated” state.
p≈0.67 is used to suggest no quality harm/equivalence. Nonsignificance is inconclusive; noninferiority/equivalence requires a justified margin and appropriate CI/test.

Different score/label/population definitions and missing provenance produce incompatible p-values. Neither is automatically authoritative because it looks plausible. Recompute one frozen estimand from raw aligned rows.
Many configs/types/regimes/scales are tested without a prospectively registered family. Use declared primary comparisons and Holm correction; mark exploratory analyses.

One queue test tests its own local implementation; other tests combine an analytical rho verdict with a broken empirical trace. Parity with old code preserves old errors. Add independent operator counterexamples.

Real prices do not supply labels for natural anomalies; injected labels establish only the declared artificial perturbation task. Separate simulation claims, external labeled tasks, and unlabeled fidelity studies.

Smaller alpha still costs an O(1) update. No demonstrated resource-saving mechanism connects pole motion alone to reduced downstream work. Measure counts and factorial effects against matched controls.
Only a few unbalanced defaults; RRCF seed/RNG and FIFO behavior require inspection, and it is not included in common system costs. Tune a justified baseline set on validation with equal budgets.

Unpinned dependency/environment breaks Numba import; JIT warms on import and costs are excluded without complete disclosure. Produce compatible locked environments; separate cold and steady execution.

Only binary profile and `seed_fixed_test` inference are supported; task scores must be probabilities for six metrics. Do not translate DSP/queue evidence into fake binary records. Build a reviewed adapter.

Same-user worker access is not an OS-separated trust boundary; HMAC “public” info contains the symmetric key; receipt CPU/memory fields contain elapsed time/zero placeholders. These are not measured hardware or independent attestation. Fix or narrow assurances before release.
No immutable raw per-event prediction/trace bundle linked to code, dependency lock, config, source hashes, and failures. Implement the bundle before expensive runs.

Five fixed colors silently omit configurations; injected data are titled “real”; frozen heatmap labeled as actual response; RRCF zero signal used as a filter output. Rebuild plots from validated typed artifacts.
